name: Universal Intermodal Services - Savannah Terminal - Savannah GA

fieldNotes.siteResolution: No street address in roster. Web search + loadmatch directory resolved Universal Intermodal Services' Savannah terminal to 6052 Commerce Court, Garden City/Savannah GA 31408 — ~1.6 mi from the Port of Savannah. Geocoded to 32.1329, -81.1751 and confirmed by satellite as a truck/intermodal terminal: a central shop/office building surrounded by a paved truck yard full of tractors and trailers, fuel tanks, and adjacent trailer-storage parcels. Street View (2025-11) shows tractors and trailers parked behind chain-link fencing. Note: 6052 Commerce Ct is shared with Mason Dixon Intermodal in directories — the audited yard is the Universal Intermodal drayage terminal at that address. Medium confidence.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The terminal yard is perimeter chain-link fenced; truck access is via a gated fenced opening off the access road on the west side. No barrier arm was directly resolved — classed truckGate true / remoteGs true (gated fenced access, no clearly visible staffed booth). C-TPAT/FAST-certified secure terminal status corroborates access control.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth positively resolved at the entrance in satellite or Street View. Access control appears fence/gate-based; classed guardShack false / remoteGs true. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: This is a drayage terminal, not a warehouse — the central building is an M&R shop (sawtooth-roof shop bays) plus office. Only a handful of shop/dock bays (~4); classed dockDoors 0-10.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive trailer/container/chassis storage: the paved core yard plus multiple adjacent unpaved storage parcels hold rows of trailers — dropArea 50+ / dropYard true. Classic drayage drop-yard.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Generous paved yard inside the gate gives ample truck holding/queue depth before the shop bays.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs along the east side of the corridor (across the highway buffer) but no spur enters the terminal property; drayage moves are truck-only. railServed = false.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-metro industrial-outdoor-storage zone in Garden City, on the western fringe of the Savannah port area — surrounded by trailer-storage yards and woods, not dense urban fabric. Rural per the rubric's small-town-industrial guidance.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale positively identified — flagged uncertain.
